signInMethods.title: Sign-in methods
signInMethods.description: Password sign-in is always on. Enable the others by adding credentials.
signInMethods.requireTwoFactor: Require two-factor authentication for all staff
signInMethods.requireTwoFactorHint: Staff without TOTP are asked to enrol at next sign-in.
signInMethods.magicLinkRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to 60.

oauth.tenantIdHint: A GUID from Entra ID. “common” and “organizations” are refused. Only work accounts of this one organisation can sign in.
oauth.allowConsumersHint: Outlook.com and Hotmail accounts, through the consumers tenant. They can only be connected from the security page, never linked by address. Off unless you need it.
oauth.tenantIdInvalid: Enter the directory ID as a GUID, like 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.
oauth.microsoftSecretHint: Paste the secret's value, not its ID. Entra secrets expire after 24 months at most: put the date in your calendar.
oauth.secretKept: Saved. Secrets are never shown again after saving.
oauth.secretSaved: Saved {{date}} by {{name}}. Secrets are never shown again after saving.
oauth.allowedDomainsHint: Empty: any Google account Google vouches for (Workspace on its own domain, or @gmail.com). With domains: only Workspace accounts on these domains. Press Enter after each one.
oauth.allowedDomainsInvalid: Enter a domain like example.com, without @.
oauth.allowedDomainsConsumer: Gmail is not a Workspace domain. Leave the list empty to allow Gmail accounts.

error.title: Settings are unavailable
error.body: The install settings could not be loaded. Try again.
error.save: The authentication settings could not be saved. Try again.

lock.hint: Locked by {{envKey}}. Remove it from {{envFile}} to edit here.

redirectUrls.title: Redirect URLs
redirectUrls.body: Register these with Google, Microsoft and GitHub:
redirectUrls.copyError: Copy failed. Select the address and copy it.

live.title: Changes apply live
live.body: A saved setting takes effect within a second, with no restart. Keys set in {{envFile}} always win and are marked with a lock.
